'''Uxibeasts''' were hair-covered [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] herbivores native to the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] and [[Voss]]. Roaming open pastures on the mountainous world, the uxibeast's horned body posed a danger to anything caught in its path when agitated.

==Overview==
Large, shaggy herbivores, the uxibeast was a large beast easily agitated and very aggressive. Pack animals most comfortable in large herds, the horned animal was no easy prey to the pouncing [[Manka cat/Legends|manka cat]] or flying [[Wingmaw/Legends|wingmaws]]; the spines along its back could easily puncture the skin of such predators. Domesticating uxibeasts was no easy challenge; the animal might imprint on a single being, forming a strong bond and loyalty with that individual.<ref name="TOR" />
